issue_context.title: Warning: state_proxy_equality_mismatch when checking Array.prototype.includes after emptying the array
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Somebody asks about this issue in the [discord server](https://discord.com/channels/457912077277855764/1317020463888728126). I don't understand why it produces the warning either but I've found that some methods to empty an array will trigger it while some won't.

### Reproduction

https://svelte.dev/playground/43325ef035f64cd3a19129d509e87139?version=5.12.0

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell
N/A
```


### Severity

annoyance
comments: @trueadm not sure if you've had a chance to check this out but seems like a bug to me.

review_comments: can this check as the others that use it be only done in DEV?  Seems kind of wasteful to do in production if an item legitimately doesn't exist.
nice!  oops, sorry, missed that this is all inside `init_array_prototype_warnings` 🤦‍♂️  which is only called in DEV
